title: Feeder baseline weight
description:
Published on <prefix>/average at QoS 0. This is the slowly-adapting estimate of the unoccupied feeder weight -- syrup level, in other words -- not an average of recent samples.

The cadence is deliberately no promise. The iteration counter advances on every sample but the publish only happens on a settled one, so these are irregular and are skipped entirely while a bird is present. Do not infer a missing message means a missing device; look at status.

BREAKING CHANGE from the predecessor: the payload was a bare formatted float ('-0.412'), not JSON. See docs/message_changes.md.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, or 0 when the clock has not been set
